scope: Separate acceptance gate for routed-MoE models whose unforced logits fail the unchanged numerical gate only through discrete expert-selection flips. It never replaces or loosens doppler.boundary-tolerance/quantized-v1; it adds routing attribution, required controls and pre-registered task-quality limits.

cpuReference.routerScore: pre-softmax router logits in float32 from the independent CPU source producer, one row per token and layer

nearTie.definition: For a token-layer where the GPU executed expert set differs from the CPU set, dropped = CPU experts the GPU did not execute, added = GPU experts outside the CPU set. flipDisplacement = max(cpuLogit[d] for d in dropped) - min(cpuLogit[a] for a in added), from the CPU reference's own router logits for that token-layer. The rank-k minus rank-(k+1) CPU margin is reported alongside it.
nearTie.envelope: Per layer, the maximum absolute difference between GPU and CPU router logits in the forced-indices control on the same case and tuple: the GPU's rounding drift on the CPU routing trajectory.
nearTie.rule: A divergence is a near-tie when flipDisplacement <= min(absoluteCeiling, envelopeMultiplier * envelope[layer]). Two logits each displaced by at most the envelope can exchange order only within twice the envelope.

attribution.coneDefinition: Divergence (L, t) is downstream of root (L0, t0) when L > L0 and t >= t0. The routed MoE output at (L0, t0) reaches later layers at the same token directly and later tokens through causal sequence mixing; it cannot reach the same layer or earlier tokens.
attribution.rootDefinition: A root is a divergence that is not downstream of any other divergence. Every non-root divergence is a cascade attributed to the roots whose cone contains it.

distribution.rationale: Teacher-forced prefill at the prompt set's sampled positions, CPU F32 reference versus GPU. The retained unforced inventory failure moved no logit more than 0.4673, so a CPU top-1 lead of at least 1 logit cannot change under that size of drift: decisive positions must all agree. Positions below that lead may flip legitimately; at most 3% may disagree. Mean KL(cpu||gpu) of 0.001 nats bounds average information loss per position; the p99 bound of 0.01 nats limits concentrated damage.

exactAnswer.rationale: Greedy answers on 22 exact-answer items. The GPU may lose at most one item the CPU reference answers correctly and at most one item net, and at least 90% of items must produce token-identical greedy continuations. The gate compares the GPU with the CPU reference on the same quantized artifact; it does not set an absolute model-quality bar.
